stage.name: Dossoles Northern Suburbs
stage.description:
Far away from the hustle and bustle of Dossoles' city center, the diehards among Pancho's underlings ensconce themselves here. Please look for a way to defeat them amidst the ever changing tide. 
<High Tide>Unable to deploy on flooded tiles. Allied units and enemies in the water will suffer from 'Erosion': Allied units have reduced ASPD, continually receive Corrosion and receive additional Corrosion when attacked; Enemies have reduced ASPD and Movement Speed, and continually lose HP

delinquent.name: Delinquent
delinquent.flavourText: The most commonly seen get-up of Dossoles's delinquents. They intermingle with tourists, ready to join in a fight at any time. Agile and nimble, they can dodge ranged Physical attacks.
abilities: Has a chance to dodge Physical attacks when not blocked

delinquent_boss.name: Delinquent Boss
delinquent_boss.flavourText: The favored get-up of pretentious delinquents. They intermingle with tourists, ready to join in a fight at any time. Better at fighting than regular delinquents, they will instinctively dodge ranged Physical attacks.
abilities: Has a chance to dodge Physical attacks when not blocked

unmanned_heavy_explosive_boat.name: Unmanned Heavy Explosive Boat
unmanned_heavy_explosive_boat.flavourText: An overloaded unmanned explosive boat with even more explosives. Causes Corrosion after exploding
abilities: Death deals Physical damage and Corrosion to surrounding units

diver.name: Diver
diver.flavourText: Their daily tasks involve cleaning up trash from the sea. The barrier to entry is low but the pay is surprisingly good, so there are many who sign up for it.
abilities: Immune to Erosion. While in water, gains increased ATK and Invisibility

tactical_hound.name: Tactical Hound
tactical_hound.flavourText: An infected creature controlled by a Caster. Hounds are widely used by mercenaries, though some Perros object to it.

unmanned_explosive_boat.name: Unmanned Explosive Boat
unmanned_explosive_boat.flavourText: An overloaded unmanned explosive boat. Causes Corrosion after exploding
abilities: Death deals Physical damage and Corrosion to surrounding units

tactical_hound_pro.name: Tactical Hound Pro
tactical_hound_pro.flavourText: An infected creature controlled by a Caster. Having gone through rigorous training, they now pose a much greater threat. Hounds are widely used by mercenaries, though some Perros object to it.

airborne_soldier_leader.name: Airborne Soldier Leader
airborne_soldier_leader.flavourText: One of Reunion's special melee soldiers, more dangerous than a normal Airborne Soldier. They are equipped with modified disposable jetpacks made from looted parts. Despite their fairly rudimentary equipment, Reunion uses them to great effect when attacking insufficiently protected areas.
abilities: Able to land directly onto the battlefield.

diver_leader.name: Diver Leader
diver_leader.flavourText: Having been trained in professional diving, they are able to reach the floor of the artificial sea and can be called the elites of the water. Even so, most of them don't dare to try it in the real seas.
abilities: Immune to Erosion. While in water, gains increased ATK and Invisibility

tidal_caster.name: Tidal Caster
tidal_caster.flavourText: Professionally trained casters whose duties involve simulating the tides of Dossoles's sea. Adept at using Originium Arts that mimic the erosive effect of the tides.
abilities: Attacks deal damage to the target and all allied units in the target's four adjacent tiles, additionally inflicting Corrosion

competition_transport_vessel.name: Competition Transport Vessel
competition_transport_vessel.flavourText: A transport vessel carrying supplies for setting up the competition venues. All competitors have the duty of protecting it from attacks.
abilities: Enemies prioritize attacking this unit, unit will deplete Life Points upon dying
Does not count towards the defeated enemies counter

tidal_leader.name: Tidal Leader
tidal_leader.flavourText: The elites among the Tidal Casters. They are in charge of leading and supervising the Tidal Casters. Extremely adept at using Originium Arts that mimic the erosive effect of the tides.
abilities: Attacks deal damage to the target and all allied units in the target's four adjacent tiles, additionally inflicting Corrosion

dockworker.name: Dockworker
dockworker.flavourText: Brawny brutes who work at the docks or on Pancho's ships. They enjoy playing cards and drinking, and usually spend the day in a drunken haze. Because they regularly work around seawater, they're more subjected to Erosion.
abilities: Stuns allied units after several attacks
Quickly loses HP while under the effects of 'Erosion'

dockworker_leader_motorboat.name: Dockworker Leader Motorboat
dockworker_leader_motorboat.flavourText: A Dockworker Leader on a motorboat. The Dockworker Leader will continue battle after the vehicle is destroyed.
abilities: Can only be blocked by units with at least 3 Block, and deals Physical damage by colliding with player's units
The <Dockworker Leader> will continue battle after the vehicle is destroyed

tidal_leader_speedboat.name: Tidal Leader Speedboat
tidal_leader_speedboat.flavourText: A Tidal Leader on a speedboat. The Tidal Leader will continue battle after the vehicle is destroyed.
abilities: Attacks deal damage to the target and all allied units in the target's four adjacent tiles, additionally inflicting Corrosion
The <Tidal Leader> will continue battle after the vehicle is destroyed

caster_speedboat.name: Caster Speedboat
caster_speedboat.flavourText: A Tidal Caster on a speedboat. The Caster will continue battle after the vehicle is destroyed.
abilities: Attacks deal damage to the target and all allied units in the target's four adjacent tiles, additionally inflicting Corrosion
The <Caster> will continue battle after the vehicle is destroyed

dockworker_leader.name: Dockworker Leader
dockworker_leader.flavourText: Giant brutes who work at the docks or on Pancho's ships. They enjoy playing cards and drinking, and usually spend the day in a drunken haze. They're much more robust than regular dockworkers, but they are still quite subjected to Erosion.
abilities: Stuns allied units after several attacks
Quickly loses HP while under the effects of 'Erosion'

dockworker_motorboat.name: Dockworker Motorboat
dockworker_motorboat.flavourText: A Dockworker on a motorboat. The Dockworker will continue battle after the vehicle is destroyed.
abilities: Can only be blocked by units with at least 3 Block, and deals Physical damage by colliding with player's units
The <Dockworker> will continue battle after the vehicle is destroyed
